note: SHA-256 pins for the mediamtx binary scripts/fetch-mediamtx.js installs (owner ruling OD-15(a): pin, fetch in CI, assert the packaged result). The digest is over the EXTRACTED executable, not the release archive, because that is the artifact the installer actually ships. bluenviron/mediamtx publishes NO checksum file for v1.9.3 and the GitHub API returns no asset digest for that release, so these values are trust-on-first-use: each is recorded once from a verified copy and enforced on every fetch afterwards. A null digest means NOT YET RECORDED - the fetch prints the observed value with a RECORD line so it can be pasted here; `--require-pin` makes an unrecorded platform a hard failure.
